verdict.rationale: ByteAsk offers an approval-gating policy (`--ask-for-approval`) and sandbox modes (`--sandbox workspace-write`) that require human approval before actions, which gives some control over agent behavior, but there is no documented mechanism for an engineering lead to explicitly allow/deny specific external tools, connectors, or MCP integrations at a policy level. Missing for 10: explicit tool/integration allowlist or blocklist controls, admin-level policy enforcement across a team, and documentation tying approval settings to specific external tool access rather than just file/code changes.
